user.title: Tommatech Local Inverter
user.description: Enter the WiFi collector dongle's IP address. Home Assistant will announce itself so the dongle connects locally instead of the cloud.

init.title: Battery tracking
init.description: Tunables for the coulomb-counted SOC and charge-stage detection. Applied immediately; the inverter connection is not interrupted.

data.tail_current_fraction: Absorption tail current, as a fraction of capacity

data_description.bank_capacity_ah: Total amp-hours at the C10 rate. 4S2P of 200 Ah blocks = 400 Ah.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Fraction of charge current that reaches storage. ~0.90 for lead-acid; the daily re-zero at absorption absorbs any error.
data_description.tail_current_fraction: 0.02 = C/50, i.e. 8 A on a 400 Ah bank. Absorption counts as finished once acceptance falls below this.
data_description.plateau_tolerance_v: How close to a setpoint counts as sitting on that plateau.
data_description.absorption_hold_min: How long the tail current must hold before the SOC counter re-zeroes to 100%.
data_description.pinned_hold_min: How long a plateau must hold before 'Battery Voltage Pinned' turns on.
